mentions.name: Pahunchi
mentions.description: A free personal safety app for women that simulates a realistic phone call with AI voice responses in the user's language (currently Hindi and English), so they can pretend to be on a call when alone in a cab or getting out of a bad date. During the call it can share location and play a voice note.
mentions.problem: Women alone in a cab or stuck on a bad date need a safe, discreet way to get out of the situation.
mentions.audience: Women who want to appear to be on a call for personal safety
mentions.source_excerpt: A free app for women to pretend to be on call when alone in a cab or to get out of a bad date. Can share location, voice note on a realistic call where AI responds in your language (currently supports Hindi, English).
mentions.author: Avijit_Thawani
